thresholds.comment: Context: orange COMPACT warning at 40%, red HANDOFF + CLEAR banner plus one desktop notification at 61%. Session/weekly turn orange at their warn pct, red near exhaustion.

alerts.comment: Desktop notification (macOS/Linux/Windows) once per session when context crosses critical. Re-arms after you compact or restart.

sections.comment: session = 5h rate-limit window (percentage only), weekly = 7-day window (percentage + days to reset), both from Claude Code's own rate_limits data.
